proposed_widenings.name: polymorph_creature
proposed_widenings.justification: The core effect of Animal Shapes replaces each target's stat block with a chosen Beast's while preserving select original properties. No v4 effect atom expresses stat-block replacement. The closest atom, alter_item_kind, applies to items not creatures.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A target's game statistics are replaced by the chosen Beast's statistics, but the target retains its creature type; Hit Points; Hit Point Dice; alignment; ability to communicate; and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores.

proposed_widenings.name: TargetSelection.any_willing
proposed_widenings.justification: Animal Shapes targets 'any number of willing creatures' with no upper bound and no slot scaling. The current TargetSelection only supports 'one' or 'choose_up_to: SlotScaling<number>'. An unbounded willing-creature selection requires a new variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose any number of willing creatures that you can see within range.

proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount.equals_target_stat
proposed_widenings.justification: The Temporary Hit Points granted equal the HP of the first beast form chosen — a stat on a player/DM-selected creature, not a computable dice expression or level-scaled formula. No existing DiceAmount variant can represent 'HP of the chosen creature form'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the first form into which it shape-shifts.

proposed_widenings.name: CastingTime or OngoingCost — magic_action recurrence
proposed_widenings.justification: The caster may spend a Magic action on later turns to re-transform targets. This is a recurring maintenance cost after the initial cast, structurally distinct from casting time. Neither CastingTime nor ClassFeatureActivationCost covers 'magic action on subsequent turns'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On later turns, you can take a Magic action to transform the targets again.

notes: Animal Shapes is fundamentally a mass-polymorph spell. Its core mechanic — replacing a creature's stat block while preserving select properties — has no corresponding effect atom in v4. The additional gaps (unbounded target selection, beast-derived temp HP, Magic action re-trigger) are secondary surface widenings but the primary blocker is the missing polymorph_creature atom. The spell could plausibly fit under ongoing_effect with a new operation kind once the atom exists. Note: the target-initiated dismiss (Bonus Action) maps to the existing v4 lifecycle atom 'dismiss' but that atom is not currently surfaced in any mechanics type — a minor secondary gap. Duration is timed 24 hours, not concentration.
